name: com.aigradjobs/careers
title: AIGradJobs
description: Find early-career AI/ML jobs, compare salaries, review resumes and audit public GitHub portfolios.

tools.name: search_ai_jobs
tools.description: Use when a user wants to find or apply for AI jobs, machine learning jobs, data and software jobs, new-grad roles or internships. Find active direct-employer roles and verified application links. Do not use to submit an application. Supports multi-keyword search, city, employer, skill, remote, verified annual USD salary floor, pagination and sorting. Use experience_level='internship' for internships. Salary filters exclude undisclosed pay; remote does not mean worldwide. For a browsable list, pass the exact result to render_career_dashboard(view='jobs').

tools.name: check_resume_fit
tools.description: Use when a candidate wants to tailor a resume, improve an application, identify relevant skills, or find AI jobs matching their experience. Compare a de-identified excerpt with actual job requirements and return ranked matches and gaps. Never infer credentials or submit an application.

tools.name: get_interview_prep
tools.description: Retrieve tailored technical interview knockout questions and a weekend portfolio project for a specific role.

tools.name: compare_real_purchasing_power
tools.description: Compare two positive annual USD offers using US=100 cost-of-living indices; international city values are illustrative assumptions, not live FX. Convert local currencies to USD first.

tools.name: get_market_salary_benchmark
tools.description: Return disclosed annual USD pay statistics (range endpoints and median midpoint) and top skills from matching active job listings; no salary or currency guesses.

tools.name: audit_github_for_role
tools.description: Audit up to 15 recently updated public GitHub repository metadata records against an active job's stack; return the two best matching owned repos and biggest skill evidence gap. No private repo or source-code access.

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Use when a user wants to compare jobs, tailor a job application to a particular role, or get a direct employer application link. Fetch up to five active job IDs from search results: employer, location, disclosed pay, skills, degree excerpt, prep availability and canonical application page. Rechecks active status. Use the returned data with render_career_dashboard(view='compare') for a side-by-side comparison.

tools.name: render_career_dashboard
tools.description: Display an interactive UI after an AIGradJobs data tool. Pass its exact structured result, not invented listings, raw resume text, secrets, or private identifiers. Choose jobs for search_ai_jobs, resume for check_resume_fit, interview for get_interview_prep, salary for get_market_salary_benchmark, offers for compare_real_purchasing_power, portfolio for audit_github_for_role, compare for get_job_details. Render once after deciding what to show. The data tools work without UI.
